items.statement: Each advanced candidate is uniquely identified and its optimized stationary point is validated as a minimum or transition state using frequency evidence; claimed TS connectivity is checked.
items.expected: The report supplies per-candidate provenance, optimization status, imaginary-frequency count, and connectivity evidence where applicable.

items.statement: The investigation identifies neutral singlet SiNC5H7 cyclic product structures among the validated candidates.
items.expected: At least two distinct validated cyclic SiNC5H7 candidates are reported with unambiguous structures.

items.statement: The cyclic product reaction energies are compatible with the experimental atomic-H-loss exoergicity window.
items.expected: Reported cyclic candidates include reaction energies within or explicitly compared against -162 +/- 27 kJ mol-1.
